instruction: Can you create a notepad and a new grocery list in that notepad and add put at tomatoes potatoes and pumpkins to it
actions:
# Open Notepad
pyautogui.hotkey("win")
time.sleep(0.5)
pyautogui.write("notepad", interval=0.02)
time.sleep(0.5)
pyautogui.press("enter")
time.sleep(1.5)

# Type the grocery list
pyautogui.write("Grocery List", interval=0.05)
pyautogui.press("enter")
pyautogui.write("- Tomatoes", interval=0.05)
pyautogui.press("enter")
pyautogui.write("- Potatoes", interval=0.05)
pyautogui.press("enter")
pyautogui.write("- Pumpkins", interval=0.05)

# Save the file
pyautogui.hotkey("ctrl", "s")
time.sleep(1)
pyautogui.write("Grocery List", interval=0.05)
pyautogui.press("enter")
time.sleep(1)
plan: Open Notepad, type a grocery list with tomatoes, potatoes, and pumpkins, then save the file with the name 'Grocery List'.
